name: First steps in Acro
description: Learn that releasing the stick stops rotation, rather than automatically levelling the drone.

steps.text: Switch to Acro with M or your mapped flight-mode control. Use small taps: centre sticks stop rotation, but you must level the drone yourself.
steps.title: Understand Acro mode

steps.text: In Acro, settle inside the hover marker. Correct the tilt yourself and keep speed below 1 m/s.
steps.title: Hover with manual levelling

steps.text: Move to the nearby marker in Acro. Counter the tilt, brake and hold position.
steps.title: Move and brake in Acro

steps.text: Return to the start marker in Acro and settle before landing.
steps.title: Return and settle

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start
